title: A Cost-Effective and Scalable Machine Learning Approach for Quality Assessment of Fresh Maize Kernel Using NIR Spectroscopy.
summary: PCA-fed ANN/PCNN maps NIR spectra to measured maize components; sample split and external cereal validations are reported. Strong for amylopectin/protein/fiber/total sugar, weaker fructose/glucose/sucrose in the main split. Scope is compositional prediction, not field or breeding impact.
